5400:
** φόβ-ητρον**, τό,
**scarecrow, bugbear, terror,** {{LXX|LXX.Isa.19.17}}: elsewhere always in _plural_ **terrors,** {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ ἱερῆς νούσου” 1 (assuming variant), 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Axiochus” 367a, NT.Luke.21.11}}; Τισιφόνης τὰ φ., probably **tragic masks** of the Furies, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|“Anthologia Graeca” 11.189 (1st c.AD: Lucillius Epigrammaticus).}}
5402: Lat. _Phoebe_, one of the daughters of Uranus and Gaia, {{8th/7th c.BC|Hesiod}}; mother of Phoebus, {{6th/5th c.BC|Aeschulus Tragicus}} (Middle Liddel)
5403:
1. **Phoenicia **, {{8th/7th c.BC|Odyssey by Homer}}, etc.; compare Φοῖνιξ.
2. **the country of Carthage **, {{Refs 5th c.BC|Euripides}} (Middle Liddel)
5405:
**φοῖνιξ**, -ικος, ο, ἡ
**Phænix, a city of Crete**: Act.27:12.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
5410:
** φόρον**, τό,
= Latin _forum,_ Ἀππίου φ. {{NT+6th c.AD+|NT.Act.28.15, compare “PLond.” 3.992.13 (6th c.AD), etc.}}
5412:
** φορτ-ίζω**,
**load,** φορτίσας τὸν ὄνον {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Babrius Fabularum Scriptor 111.3}}; φορτία φ. τινάς **load** them **with** burdens, {{NT|NT.Luke.11.46}}; περισσῇ δαπάνῃ φ. τὰ κοινά Dörner **Erlass des Statthalters von Asia Paullus Fabius Persicus**{{Refs|16; ὑδατὶς -ίζουσα τὸν ὀφθαλμόν}}**encumbering,** {{Refs 7th c.AD+|7th c.AD: Paulus Aegineta Medicus 6.14}}; αὐχένα φ. Aenigma Sphingis (cited in {{Refs 5th c.BC+|Scholia 5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Phoenissae” 50):}} —_middle_, τὰ μείονα φορτίζεσθαι **ship** the smaller part of one's wealth, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th-7th c.BC: Hesiodus Epicus “Opera et Dies” 690}}; φορτιούμενος μέλι **to carry away a load** of honey, {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Macho Comicus cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 13.582f: _metaphorically_, φυτεύειν καὶ φ. 1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “περὶ κακιῶν ί” p.33J.}}—_passive_, **to be heavy laden,** πεφορτισμένος {{NT+2nd c.AD+|NT.Matt.11.28, compare 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Nav.” 45.}}
5415:
**φορτούνατος** (Rec. Φουρ-, see Mayser, 116 f.), -ου, ὁ
(Lat.) Fortunatus: 1Co.16:17 (see Lft., Cl. Ro., 1Co., 59).†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
5423:
** φρενᾰπᾰτ-ης**, ου, ὁ,
**soul-deceiver,** {{NT+6th c.AD+|Lyric poetry Alex.Adesp. 1.18, NT.Tit.1.10, “PLond.” 5.1677.22 (6th c.AD).}}
5435:
**φρυγία**, -ας, ἡ
(prop., the adj., Φρυγίος, -α, -ον; sc. γῆ, χώρα),
**Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor**: Act.2:10; Φ. καὶ Γαλατικὴ χώρα (Γ. χ. κ. Φ.), Act.16:6 18:23 (on these phrases see _DB_, i, 89 f.; CGT, _Gal._, xxii f.).†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
5436:
**φύγελος** (Rec. -λλος), -ου, ὁ
**Phygelus**: 2Ti.1:15.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
5448:
** φῡσιόω**,
(φῦσα) **puff up,** [{{NT|NT.1Cor.8.1 (for _Epic dialect_ _participle_ φυσιόων see at {φυσιάω})}}]:—_passive_, πρὸς τὰ θέματα πεφυσιωμένος {{NT+1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “Po.Herc.” 1676.9, cf. NT.1Cor.4.6; ὑπολήψεις πεφ. 1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “Mus.” p.26 K.}}
5450:
** φῡσίωσις**, εως, ἡ,
**inflation,** [{{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus]14.386 (_plural_)}}: _metaphorically_, **being puffed up, pride,** {{NT|NT.2Cor.12.20 (_plural_).}}
5457:
** φῶς**,
_contraction_ for φάος, **light** (which see). **φῴς**, ἡ, _plural_ φῷδες, _contraction_ from φωΐς (which see).
5468:
** χᾰλῑνᾰγωγ-έω**,
**guide with** or **as with bit and bridle,** γλῶσσαν, σῶμα, {{NT+2nd c.AD+|NT.Jam.1.26, 3.2, compare 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Salt.” 70, “Tyr.” 4; ἄνθρωπον 2nd c.AD: Vettius Valens Astrologus 248.25, compare 6th c.AD: Choricius Rhetor 32.139p.376 F.-R., 4th c.AD: Libanius Sophista “Declamationes” 3 “Intr.” 1.}}
5474:
** χαλκο-λίβᾰνος** [ῐ], ου, ἡ,
either **fine brass, brass of Lebanon,** or **yellow frankincense,** {{NT|NT.Rev. 1.15, 2.18.}}

5478:
**Χαναναῖος**, -α, -ον
**Canaanite**: γυνή, Mat.15:22.†

5486:
** χᾰρ-ισμα**, ατος, τό,
**grace, favour,** θεοῦ {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 1.102, compare “fragment” 84 H.}}; especially in **NT, gift of God's grace,** {{NT|NT.1Cor.12.4, +others}}; opposed to ὀψώνια, {{NT|NT.Rom.6.23}}; later, generally, **favour bestowed**, {{Refs 4th c.AD+|“BGU” 1044.4 (_plural_, 4th c.AD).}}
5487:
** χαρῐτ-όω**,
**show grace to** any one, τῆς χάριτος ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς {{NT|NT.Eph.1.6:—}}_middle_ χαριτώσομαι I **will bestow favour** upon thee, {{Refs 4th c.AD+|“BGU” 1026 xxiii 24 (4th c.AD)}}:—_passive_, **to have grace shown one, to be highly favoured,** {{LXX+NT|LXX.Sir.18.17, NT.Luke.1.28}}; πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους{{Refs 4th c.AD+|Aristeas 225, compare 4th c.AD: Hephaestio Astrologus 1.1}}; ὄμμα στροφαῖς -ούμενον probably in {{Refs 4th c.AD+|4th c.AD: Libanius Sophista “Descriptiones” 30.12.}}
5488:
**χαρράν **
indecl. (in FlJ., _Ant._, i, 16, 1, Κάρρα, -ας, ib. 6, 5, Χαρρά, -ᾶς; so LXX: Gen.29:4 E, Eze.27:28 B, elsewhere -άν­Heb. חָרָן), Haran, a town in N.W. Mesopotamia: Act.7:2, 4.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
5496:
** χειρᾰγωγ-έω**,
**lead by the hand,** τινα {{LXX+1st c.AD+|LXX.Judg.16.26 codex A, 1st c.AD: Musonius Philosophus “fragment” 15Ap.79H., NT.Act.9.8, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Cleomenes” 38}}: generally, **guide, direct,** φρυκτώρια ἐς ἀσφαλεῖς καταγωγὰς τὰς ναῦς χ. {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Herodianus Grammaticus 4.2.8}}; χ. τούτῳ τὴν ἔξοδον will **guide** his exit, Procop.Gaz.{{Refs 1st c.BC+|p.158B.: _metaphorically_, χ. τὴν εὕρεσιν μνήμῃ 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.48b; τὴν ψυχὴν ἐπί τι 1st c.BC(?): Maximus Astrologus Tyr. 10.6}}; also **'lead by the nose', cajole,** {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|2nd-1st c.BC: Posidonius Historicus 36J.: _absolutely_, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Tim.” 32, 3rd c.AD: Porphyrius Tyrius Philosophus “adversus Christianos - Abh. Berl. Akad.” 30}}:—_passive_, {{LXX+3rd c.BC+|LXX.Tob.11.16 codex א ὑπ᾽ αὐτῶν τῶν πραγμάτων “PPetr.” 3p.22 (3rd c.BC),compare 1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 13.20; ἐπί τι 2nd c.AD: Herodianus Grammaticus 7.1.2.}}
5499:
** χειρο-ποίητος**, ον,
**made by hand, artificial,** opposed to αὐτοφυής (natural), σκῆπτρον {{LXX+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.195; λίμνη 2.149; ἔργον 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Critias” 118c; ὁδός 5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Anabasis” 4.3.5; τείχη 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 4.10.5; γήλοφος, τέλμα 4th c.AD: Julianus Imperator “Orationes” 2.63b, 65c: frequently in LXX of idols, LXX.Isa.2.18, +others}}; φλὸξ χ. a fire **intentionally kindled,** opposed to ἀπὸ ταὐτομάτου, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 2.77}}; so λιμός, opposed to αὐτόματος, {{Refs 6th c.AD+|6th c.AD: Procopius Caesariensis Historicus “Historia Arcana” 26}}; ἀνάγκη, τέχνη, {{Refs|[prev. author] “Goth.” 4.26, 22}}. _adverb_ **χειρό-τως** {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 10.10.12: χ.ὠχύρωτο, opposed to φύσει, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 7.8.3.}}
